sql: SELECT "set_translations"."setCode", "sets"."mcmName" FROM "set_translations" JOIN "sets" ON "set_translations"."setCode" = "sets"."code" ORDER BY "set_translations"."setCode" ASC, "sets"."mcmName" ASC LIMIT 20

question: Which are the top 5 Name values by avg DownVotes, breaking ties by Name descending? Use only the badges.UserId to users.Id relationship. Measure the AVG of users.DownVotes over these matched rows. Sort first by aggregate_value descending, then by group_value descending; apply the row limit after sorting.
sql: SELECT "badges"."Name" AS group_value, AVG("users"."DownVotes") AS aggregate_value FROM "badges" JOIN "users" ON "badges"."UserId" = "users"."Id" GROUP BY "badges"."Name" ORDER BY aggregate_value DESC, group_value DESC LIMIT 5
